decisions.reason: Because GA4 is the current analytics standard and the plugin is central to the firm's analytics services, the firm continues to commit to it despite any weak outcomes.
The firm has already invested in the retail-system interface and still attributes weak results to temporary factors because it underpins integration offerings, so it keeps the plugin.
The shop relaunch SEO support service has high public visibility with its own page and is central to the announced direction, so the firm escalates commitment and keeps it.
The SEO workshops are presented on their own page and align with the firm's search marketing direction, so the firm keeps them and treats any weak demand as a temporary launch effect.
